fact: The Ministry of Digital Affairs DPPD 2024-2026 sets the broadband internet penetration target at 40% in 2024, 45% in 2025 and 50% in 2026 from a 37.16% baseline, within the Numérique programme linked to the PAG 2021-2026 broadband phase 2 project.
title: DPPD 2024-2026 Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation (035)
publisher: Ministère de l'Économie et des Finances (Bénin)
